'''House Kigarin''' is the royal house of [[Ghealdan]].
==House members==
*[[Alliandre Maritha Kigarin]], Blessed of the [[Light]], [[Defender of Garen's Wall]], Queen of Ghealdan. Sworn to Lord [[Perrin Aybara]].
==Activities==
Alliandre Maritha Kigarin is raised to the throne of Ghealdan after the abdication of Queen [[Teresia]]. She only manages to survive by placating [[Masema Dagar]].{{ref/book|5|39}} 

To save her nation, Alliandre swore fealty to Lord [[Perrin Aybara]] after meeting with him.{{ref/book|8|10}} 
== Trivia ==
* It is unknown whether King [[Johanin]], Queen [[Ellizelle]], and Queen [[Teresia]] were of House Kigarin, or if Alliandre was the first of her House to ascend to the throne.
